content:
jon: Noticed multiple entries in partner logs with `kms_ciphertext` + `keyName`. Seen in gs://partner-ship/logs/2026-03-21/*.jsonl. Flagging for sec triage.

lina: can you paste one sanitized line (no secret material)? we need to confirm it's a KMS wrapped blob vs something else.

jon: sanitized: `{"ts":"2026-03-21T09:03:12Z","svc":"partner-exec","payload":{"kms_ciphertext":"Ci0AXXX...XXX","kms_key":"projects/2345/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/ingest-key"}}`

ravi: thanks. this includes the KMS resource path. first step: assume potential plaintext exposure and identify principals that had decrypt rights.

dev-ops: running IAM query now: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ingest-key --keyring=partners --project=2345` will enumerate bindings.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-054 created (severity: P2). Runbook: /runbooks/kms-leak-response. Add evidence docs.

lina: note: partner's CI ran a pre-wrap step last week per docs; need to confirm whether they logged outputs before calling KMS. I've opened partner ticket and asked for build IDs.

jon: also found a CI job `partner-ci/deploy` in the log lines around same time that uploaded a file with `publicRead` ACL set briefly (suspect misconfig).

ravi: plan outline: 1) snapshot logs and export to our secure BigQuery dataset for search 2) create new cryptoKeyVersion and mark old version disabled 3) revoke decrypt IAM bindings from partner SA 4) rotate downstream secrets (service tokens, API keys) 5) ask partner to run rewrap test if they still have plaintext 6) enable HSM-backed key option if feasible.

oncall-ops: I can execute rotation in 45m. Need go/no-go and list of affected SAs. Who owns the partner SA?

dev-ops: found binding: `member: serviceAccount:partner-integration@partner.gserviceaccount.com` has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` at the key level. Also `partner-ci@partner.gserviceaccount.com` appears in logs.

lina: lock step: remove direct decrypt role from those SAs and replace with an impersonation flow using our `kms-proxy` service account (short-lived tokens). That avoids giving long-lived decrypt rights.

jon: adding commands for export: `gsutil cp gs://partner-ship/logs/2026-03-21/*.jsonl gs://redwood-forensics/temp/` then `bq load redwood_forensics.kms_evidence gs://redwood-forensics/temp/*.jsonl schema.json`.

ravi: RBAC change proposal: create conditional binding with `condition: request.time < timestamp("2026-03-21T18:00:00Z")` to expire any remaining bindings, then rotate keys.

sec-bot: Reminder: extend audit log retention for projects 2345 and partners-bucket for +90 days while investigation ongoing.

oncall-ops: assigning action owners: jon (log sweep + evidence export), dev-ops (IAM changes + disable key version), lina (partner liaison + CI review), ravi (rotate downstream tokens and tests). I'll perform key disable during the maintenance window.

lina: partner confirmed they use a custom logger that redacts `Authorization` but not `payload`. they claim they never logged plaintext, but we'll still rotate and assume worst-case.

jon: quick test before rotation: run decrypt attempt with partner SA (in a sandbox) to see if it still decrypts. `gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=partners --key=ingest-key --ciphertext-file=sample.ct --plaintext-file=-`. do NOT paste outputs in channel.

dev-ops: created new key version: `projects/2345/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/ingest-key/cryptoKeyVersions/3` and set it as primary. leaving old version (v2) disabled after rotation.

ravi: after rotation we should run downstream certificate/token rotation script: `./scripts/rotate-service-creds --project=2345 --owners=partner-services` and revoke any active refresh tokens.

lina: also recommend adding an organization policy to block objects with `publicRead` ACLs and enable GCS object lifecycle to require data classification tags for partner buckets.

noncall-ops: rotation complete. old key v2 disabled. partner rewrap test pending. We've revoked decrypt binding from partner-integration SA.

jon: evidence saved to INC-2026-054. timeline updated with samples and IAM diff.

lina: follow-ups: 1) schedule postmortem with partner and infra 2) add a short-lived impersonation onboarding doc for partners 3) enable HSM-backed keys for high-risk partners 4) codify redaction rules for partner loggers.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-054 status: mitigation complete, monitoring. Please create postmortem within 7 days.

ravi: noted. i'll own the postmortem draft. thanks team.

jon: thanks everyone. I'll close the ticket after partner confirms rewrap or we finish downstream rotations.
